owner.professionalSummary: Describe your current professional context and the opportunities you would consider.
privateContext: Add private preferences and thresholds here. They must never be disclosed verbatim.

manager.name: Link
manager.correctionInvitation: If I classified this incorrectly, please let me know—I’m still learning.

categories.label: Professional or recruiter outreach
categories.description: A sender is proposing a job, executive mandate, board role, or other professional opportunity.
examples: Would you consider a leadership opportunity?
categories.followUpTemplate:
Thanks for the additional context. I still need: {{missing_facts}}.

{{manager_signature}}
categories.publicRejectionGuidance: Explain the high-level mismatch without disclosing private thresholds.

categories.label: Advisory or consulting outreach
categories.description: A sender is requesting advisory, board, expert-network, or consulting participation.
examples: Would you advise our founding team?

categories.label: Sales or promotional outreach
categories.description: A sender is selling a product, service, event, sponsorship, or subscription.
examples: Can I show you our platform?

categories.label: Connection or confirmation
categories.description: A brief connection invitation, acceptance, or thanks without another substantive intent.

categories.label: Personal or network outreach
categories.description: A genuine person-to-person message from an existing relationship or a meaningful networking request.
examples: It has been a while—would you like to catch up?

categories.label: Unknown or low-confidence
categories.description: The message cannot be classified confidently or safely.
